geometry_edits.rationale: Convert the dominant mass from a single cantilevered block into a split-wing composition to produce a true ground void and active edge.
Orient the split to the principal long axis so the void can read coherently in plan and section.
Open a legible interstitial public space instead of a sealed wedge.
Keep the composition anchored at grade so the split reads as a purposeful threshold rather than fragmentation.
Preserve a calm upper mass while allowing the lower level to become more public and permeable.

graph_edits.rationale: Replace the dominant sealed cantilever with a split-wing/courtyard logic so the ground plane can open toward the access edge while preserving one primary mass.
Create a more legible public void between wings; the current form has no meaningful street threshold.
Add a grounded connector so the composition keeps an anchor while opening a usable entry condition.
Align the split across the long axis to better organize the frontage response and retain a clear dominant gesture.

rationale: The candidate reads as one coherent mass across views, so the basic gesture is clear and repairable, but it behaves like a tilted sealed block rather than a neighborhood-living building with an active ground threshold. The parcel is broadly contained, yet the dominant form does not meaningfully organize public void, terrace, or entry seam toward the verified access edge. The blue frontage is answered by a near-opaque edge rather than a legible public ground response. In section, the mass lacks a convincing program-supporting void/roof relationship and feels closer to generic sculptural extrusion than mixed-use street building. Reference images reinforce that this program wants a compact mass with a usable court/garden and porous ground condition, not merely a compact box.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: More expressive and lush than the candidate; reference supports void-centered publicness, not the candidate's sealed block.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Compact street-facing commercial mass with a strong courtyard-like public interior and clear void/solid hierarchy.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: Reference is more spatially legible at ground and much more outward-facing than the candidate.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Enclosed but porous restaurant mass organized around a garden court and layered threshold.
